paths.title: Web Architect Sprint
paths.description: Every category in a recommended order for a web or solution architect interview, from application foundations out to platform concerns.

paths.title: Frontend Architecture
paths.description: React, micro frontends, performance and accessibility: how a large user interface is built, split, measured and kept usable.

paths.title: APIs and Integration
paths.description: REST design, API management, content APIs and the resilience patterns that keep integrations healthy.

paths.title: Cloud and Delivery
paths.description: AWS building blocks, CDN and caching, and the MACH composable-architecture approach.

paths.title: Digital Experience Platforms
paths.description: Headless CMS and AEM, technical SEO, and customer-data, analytics and experimentation concepts.

paths.title: Design and Scenario Drills
paths.description: Only the scenario and system-design questions from every category. Best after you know the basics.
